parents.anchor: Scaling AI at Sandvik; AI in sales and support
parents.finding: Operational Manufacturing Copilot retrieves brand documentation. 20–30% employee time savings and sales onboarding are different populations; narrow the workflow before assigning metrics.

parents.anchor: Transforming logistics with Copilot; Shaping a smarter supply chain with AI agents
parents.finding: Freight invoice review compares negotiated rates and flags discrepancies. Millions of dollars in first-year savings are anticipated, not measured.

parents.anchor: Consolidating weeks of policy, claim, and documentation digestion into days
parents.finding: OCR and Azure OpenAI extract and classify insurance documents. 2.6 billion historical policies/claims spans the platform and must not be assigned to the new GenAI extraction workflow.

parents.anchor: aiR for Review; more than 100 million legal decisions since launch; Azure costs over five years
parents.finding: Operational discovery document review supported. The 73% reduction is five-year Azure cost management, not a document-review AI treatment effect.

parents.anchor: Ontada unearths unparalleled clinical data; A single platform delivers speed and compliance
parents.finding: Azure Document Intelligence and OpenAI extract oncology entities. 150 million documents in three weeks and 75% processing-time reduction refer to extraction; trial matching and care-gap analysis are downstream workflows.

parents.anchor: Shifting focus to more strategic work; Improving overall efficiency of financial operations
parents.finding: IBM finance journal-entry automation deployed in early 2025. >90% cycle reduction and USD600000 annual savings are explicitly estimated/projected.

parents.anchor: Navigating the claims flood; Streamlining operations across the insurance value chain
parents.finding: CCG uses watsonx, workflow automation and RPA in property claims. Claims platform spans coverage guidance, agents and vendors; keep aggregate KPIs from unrelated child hypotheses.
